author: Gamers Nexus
description:
Sponsor: Montech HS01 Pro on Amazon https://geni.us/UYLeZn and HS02 Pro https://geni.us/ABM9fEB
We're benchmarking Intel's new Arrow Lake Refresh Ultra 5 250K Plus CPU, including tests vs. the Intel 245K, AMD 9600X, 9700X, 9800X3D, 5800X3D, and more. Intel's 250K Plus CPU has an MSRP of $200 and release date of March 26th, 2026, with a reconfiguration of the cores and clocks compared to the Intel 245K CPU. Our benchmarks look at gaming performance, production performance in workloads like code compiling (testing the best CPUs for programmers), video editing and rendering, Photoshop, and more. We also briefly test power consumption. The 250K Plus is launching alongside the Intel Ultra 7 270K Plus, which we'll review in a separate video coming up.

See also our 9850X3D CPU review: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-InE1Nebnj8
Our Crimson Desert benchmarks and simulation time error testing: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1tz4u5oYx_o

title: Intel Ultra 5 250K Plus CPU Review & Benchmarks: Gaming, Production, & Power Consumption
